rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL: AI-Generated Claims Document Detection")`
`comment("Flags claims documents with AI generation metadata anomalies")`
index=flame_insurance sourcetype=flame:claims_processing
  (document_type="photo" OR document_type="invoice"
   OR document_type="medical_record" OR document_type="repair_estimate")
| eval anomaly_type = case(
    document_type="photo" AND isnull(exif_camera_model), "missing_camera_metadata",
    match(creation_tool, "(?i)(stable.diffusion|midjourney|dall-e|comfyui)"),
      "ai_tool_signature",
    gan_artifact_score > 0.7, "gan_artifacts",
    frequency_domain_anomaly_score > 0.8, "frequency_anomaly",
    isnotnull(exif_gps_coordinates) AND exif_gps_loss_location_match="false",
      "gps_mismatch",
    1=1, null())
| where isnotnull(anomaly_type)
| stats count AS flagged_documents,
        values(anomaly_type) AS anomaly_types,
        sum(claim_amount) AS total_claim_value,
        dc(document_id) AS unique_documents
  BY claim_id, claimant_id, claim_type
| sort - flagged_documents
rules.title: DL-0194: AI-Generated Claims Document Detection — Metadata Anomalies and Generation Tool Signatures (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL: Deepfake Vehicle Damage Photo Pattern Detection")`
`comment("Detects AI-generated vehicle damage photos via pixel and metadata analysis")`
index=flame_insurance sourcetype=flame:claims_processing
  (claim_type="vehicle_collision" OR claim_type="vehicle_comprehensive"
   OR claim_type="vehicle_vandalism")
  document_type="photo"
| eval is_flagged = case(
    pixel_artifact_score > 0.8, 1,
    lighting_consistency_score < 0.3, 1,
    shadow_consistency_score < 0.3, 1,
    ai_generation_probability > 0.75, 1,
    isnull(exif_camera_model) AND isnotnull(exif_software), 1,
    1=1, 0)
| where is_flagged=1
| eval primary_indicator = case(
    pixel_artifact_score > 0.8, "high_pixel_artifacts",
    lighting_consistency_score < 0.3, "inconsistent_lighting",
    shadow_consistency_score < 0.3, "inconsistent_shadows",
    ai_generation_probability > 0.75, "high_ai_probability",
    isnull(exif_camera_model) AND isnotnull(exif_software), "metadata_anomaly",
    1=1, "multiple_indicators")
| eval combined_score = round(
    (coalesce(pixel_artifact_score, 0) * 0.3)
    + ((1 - coalesce(lighting_consistency_score, 1)) * 0.2)
    + ((1 - coalesce(shadow_consistency_score, 1)) * 0.2)
    + (coalesce(ai_generation_probability, 0) * 0.3), 3)
| stats count AS flagged_photos,
        values(primary_indicator) AS indicators,
        max(combined_score) AS max_deepfake_score,
        sum(claim_amount) AS total_claim_value
  BY claim_id, claimant_id, claim_type, vehicle_vin
| sort - max_deepfake_score
rules.title: DL-0195: Deepfake Vehicle Damage Photo Pattern — Pixel Artifacts, Lighting Inconsistencies, and AI Generation Indicators (SPLUNK)
